verdict.rationale: The axis applies: Webfile/eSystems is an online filing portal, and a portal like this could publish its operating hours, daily limits, or session timeouts. None of the evidence mentions any operating-hours window, per-day transaction limit, or session-timeout disclosure. The items only describe filing options, payment methods, and that Webfile sits behind an authenticated eSystems session.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
